# Juan Vasquez — AI Enablement & Technology Specialist

> Juan Vasquez is a technology professional in Sonora, Mexico. His public positioning combines AI enablement with hands-on IT support and infrastructure experience. He helps teams and businesses discover practical AI use cases, train users by role, and develop clearly scoped prototypes. The main portfolio defaults to English and offers Spanish; a hidden just-for-fun Chinese translation is also available.
